# About Me

::: {.bio}
I am a postdoctoral researcher at Emory University, working with [Howard Chang](https://sph.emory.edu/profile/faculty/howard-chang) and [Razieh Nabi](https://raziehnabi.com/), and a member of the [SPENSER lab](https://www.spenser-lab.org/). My research develops statistical methods for public health impact by addressing problems in environmental health, electronic health records, and disease surveillance, using tools from **causal inference**, **dimension reduction**, and **spatiotemporal statistics**. I received my PhD in Biostatistics from Emory in 2025, advised by [Lance Waller](https://sph.emory.edu/profile/faculty/lance-waller) and was previously a Post-Bachelor Fellow at the Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME). I am currently on the **2026–2027 academic job market**.
:::
